description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 17.06.2024 to 23.06.2024
categorisation: This gazette content is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance, establishing new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for customs operations, published as a statutory instrument by the Director General of Customs.
